How Neighborhood Delivery Works

- Before Pick Up Day -

Create an Account - Start an Order

Create an account on our site if you don't already have one. Search 'Your Zip Code' in the Pickup Locations page, and set your location to the nearest Neighborhood Delivery site. Start an order by adding items to your cart.

Confirm Your Order

Once you click "Confirm" you'll receive an email with the estimated total of your order. This is NOT a payment. Since some products are priced by weight, your card will NOT be charged for the exact total until Delivery Day.

Forgot Something?

No problem! You can log onto your account anytime up til the order deadline (2 days before Delivery Day) to make needed changes or additions to your order!

Start an Order

- On Pick Up Day -

We Pack Your Order

Orders are packed at the Farm on Delivery Day! We pack all your items in plastic bags that go into blue Whiffletree cooler bags tagged with your name. The blue bags go into our large coolers that you'll find at your Neighborhood Delivery Location. $7 flat rate for all orders under $125. Free delivery on orders $125 or over.

Payment is Processed - We Deliver

After your order is weighed, packed, and loaded on the Delivery van, your payment is processed (totals may vary slightly from estimated totals you received earlier). You'll receive a confirmation and receipt.

We deliver your order in large coolers to your neighborhood location.

You Pick Up

Follow these guidelines to pick up:

1) FIND the large coolers in plain sight at your Neighborhood Delivery
2) LOOK inside for the bags tagged with your name (your order may be in multiple bags)
3) TAKE your plastic bags out of the blue cooler bags, leave cooler bags behind, and close the cooler lid firmly
4) CHECK how many eggs you ordered and grab them from the egg box (egg amounts will be on your emailed receipt, your blue cooler bag tag, and the egg sheet with the egg box.

Whiffletree will process orders on Monday around lunchtime and will contact you immediately if your payment method fails. If we have not received payment by Tuesday at 7:30am, your order will not be sent out for delivery.

Any orders cancelled between Monday at 7:30am and Tuesday at 7:30am will be subject to a $20 restocking fee.

No cancellation of orders after 7:30am on Tuesday.

You will receive an email reminder on Monday and a text message on Tuesday afternoon. We cannot guarantee any further reminders.

All meat comes frozen for food safety. We recommend thawing it in a container in your fridge.
There may be some leakage despite vacuum-sealed packaging.

We offer fresh chicken in the farm store Wed to Sat, May to Oct. First come, first serve.

Have a Neighborhood Question? Let us know!
